_comments: The hardcoded UUID is deliberate and matches the convention every seeded row here follows: a
stable ID means pushing twice updates one row rather than creating two, and a deployment that
renames this company keeps its pipelines pointing at it.

fields.Name: Default Company
fields.Description: Placeholder selling company created by the bizapps-sales install, because a pipeline cannot exist without one. Rename it, or repoint the seeded pipelines at a real company.
